newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar drifts to lower close with Australian.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar drifts to lower close with Australian.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar drifted to a slightly weaker close on Wednesday in sympathy with its Australian counterpart.
The currency closed at US$0.7093/00 and 67.93 on its Trade-Weighted Index, down a touch from its opening 0.7097/04 and 67.97.
Some U.S. buying took Kiwi above 71 cents early in the session and it traded as high at 0.7110 before tracking lower in line with the Australian dollar.
Dealers said there was buying of yen and selling of Australian dollars. They said the weak price of gold and rumours of a possible rate cut were among factors weighing on the Aussie.
A 0.9 percent fall in New Zealand M-3 money supply and a 0.3 percent decline in private sector credit for November were seen as encouraging for the Reserve Bank but did not affect the currency.
